ssm.tagline: Steam dedicated servers, managed entirely through a GUI
ssm.desc: A desktop app for Windows and Linux that lets you search, install, configure and run Steam dedicated servers, all from a GUI. No SteamCMD command-line work, no hand-editing config files: anyone can search, download, configure and launch.

screenshots.dashboard: Dashboard: registered servers and their status
screenshots.search: Server search: find and install supported titles
screenshots.config: Config editor: edit settings through the GUI

search.title: Server Search
search.desc: Find the dedicated server for your game right inside the app. No SteamCMD knowledge required.

install.title: One-Click Install
install.desc: Download and install straight from the search results. No command-line work at all.

config.title: GUI Config Editor
config.desc: Adjust server settings from the GUI, with no hand-editing of config files.

launch.title: Launch & Stop Control
launch.desc: Start, stop and monitor your servers at a glance, all in one place.

update.title: Auto Updates
update.desc: The app keeps itself up to date automatically, so you are always on the latest version.

multi.title: Multiple Servers
multi.desc: Register multiple game servers and switch between them as you operate.

mods.title: Mod Management
mods.desc: Install and manage mods entirely through the GUI.

backup.title: Auto Backups
backup.desc: Server data is backed up automatically, just in case.

search.title: Search
search.desc: Find the dedicated server for the game you want to host, inside the app.

install.title: Download

configure.title: Configure

launch.desc: Start the server with a single button. Then just play.

pricing.note: Pro is a one-time license. No subscription.

core.label: Search, install, configure and run servers

network.label: Network
network.value: An internet connection is required to download and update server files.

storage.label: Storage
storage.value: The app itself is about 7 MB. Disk usage grows with each game server you install.

games.a: You can search for and install any dedicated-server title distributed through SteamCMD. Check the in-app search for supported titles.

license.a: Yes. Pro costs ¥1,980 once, with no monthly fees. One license can be activated on up to 3 devices.

difference.q: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
difference.a: Free lets you register one server. Pro adds multiple server registrations, mod management and automatic backups.

updates.a: No. The app updates itself automatically, free of charge.

refund.q: Can I get a refund after purchase?
refund.a: No. Because a license key is issued at the time of purchase, refunds are not available. Please try the Free version first to make sure the app works for you.
